assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
Diagnosis codes I48.0, G45.9, Z86.73 are associated with the patient.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management.
CPT code 93229 corresponds to Mobile cardiac telemetry.
These are intermittent events, so precertification cannot be obtained in advance.
The service is medically necessary to document the arrhythmia and support the patient's history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
